critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the front cylinder of the upper deck hump to increase its length by 40% along the longitudinal axis, expand its diameter by 25% to widen the cabin area, and increase its vertical radius by 30% to create a more pronounced curve. Ensure the junction between this cylinder and the main fuselage is smoothed using a fillet or tapered transition to eliminate the abrupt edge.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck hump ends very close to the cockpit area.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: An abrupt transition between the upper deck and the main body.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve blending into the main fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears relatively flat compared to the reference.
discrepancies.reference: A more pronounced, rounded elevation above the main deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical radius of front cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck section is narrow and lacks volume.
discrepancies.reference: A wide, substantial cabin area for passengers.
